title: Never listening to her own records
summary: Humes never plays her own records and always feels they could have been better, though she hears playbacks in the studio and asks to sing again.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Yeah, that's wonderful. So, of course when you made records and so on, you'd listen to yourself too, and you'd get some impression too?
I don't ever play any records of mine.

No, never. When I came here I sent out my albums, you know, and she put them on and I said, 'is that my record?' She said, yes. I said, 'well I like this one'. She said, now don't tell me you haven't heard it. I said, 'I heard none of them. I never listen to my records'. I don't know, I always feel like they could have been better, you know. When you're in the studio they play them back and I hear them then.
